12 # Convex hull
13 
14 This file defines the convex hull of a set `s` in a module. `convexHull 𝕜 s` is the smallest convex
15 set containing `s`. In order theory speak, this is a closure operator.
16 
17 ## Implementation notes
18 
19 `convexHull` is defined as a closure operator. This gives access to the `ClosureOperator` API
20 while the impact on writing code is minimal as `convexHull 𝕜 s` is automatically elaborated as
21 `(convexHull 𝕜) s`.
22 -/
23 
24 @[expose] public section
25

28

32

36

41 variable (𝕜)
42 variable [AddCommMonoid E] [AddCommMonoid F] [Module 𝕜 E] [Module 𝕜 F]

44 /-- The convex hull of a set `s` is the minimal convex set that includes `s`. -/
45 @[simps! isClosed]
46 def convexHull : ClosureOperator (Set E) := .ofCompletePred (Convex 𝕜) fun _ ↦ convex_sInter
47 
48 variable (s : Set E)
49 
50 theorem subset_convexHull : s ⊆ convexHull 𝕜 s :=
51   (convexHull 𝕜).le_closure s
52 
53 theorem convex_convexHull : Convex 𝕜 (convexHull 𝕜 s) := (convexHull 𝕜).isClosed_closure s
54 
55 theorem convexHull_eq_iInter : convexHull 𝕜 s = ⋂ (t : Set E) (_ : s ⊆ t) (_ : Convex 𝕜 t), t := by
56   simp [convexHull, iInter_subtype, iInter_and]
57 
58 variable {𝕜 s} {t : Set E} {x y : E}
59 
60 theorem mem_convexHull_iff : x ∈ convexHull 𝕜 s ↔ ∀ t, s ⊆ t → Convex 𝕜 t → x ∈ t := by
61   simp_rw [convexHull_eq_iInter, mem_iInter]
62 
63 theorem convexHull_min : s ⊆ t → Convex 𝕜 t → convexHull 𝕜 s ⊆ t := (convexHull 𝕜).closure_min
64 
65 theorem Convex.convexHull_subset_iff (ht : Convex 𝕜 t) : convexHull 𝕜 s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ t :=
66   (show (convexHull 𝕜).IsClosed t from ht).closure_le_iff
67 
68 @[mono, gcongr]
69 theorem convexHull_mono (hst : s ⊆ t) : convexHull 𝕜 s ⊆ convexHull 𝕜 t :=
70   (convexHull 𝕜).monotone hst
71 
72 lemma convexHull_eq_self : convexHull 𝕜 s = s ↔ Convex 𝕜 s := (convexHull 𝕜).isClosed_iff.symm
73 
74 alias ⟨_, Convex.convexHull_eq⟩ := convexHull_eq_self
75 
76 @[simp]
77 theorem convexHull_univ : convexHull 𝕜 (univ : Set E) = univ :=
78   ClosureOperator.closure_top (convexHull 𝕜)
79 
80 @[simp]
81 theorem convexHull_empty : convexHull 𝕜 (∅ : Set E) = ∅ :=
82   convex_empty.convexHull_eq
83 
84 @[simp]
85 theorem convexHull_eq_empty : convexHull 𝕜 s = ∅ ↔ s = ∅ := by
86   constructor
87   · intro h
88     rw [← Set.subset_empty_iff, ← h]
89     exact subset_convexHull 𝕜 _
90   · rintro rfl
91     exact convexHull_empty
92 
93 @[simp]
94 theorem convexHull_nonempty_iff : (convexHull 𝕜 s).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty := by
95   rw [nonempty_iff_ne_empty, nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, Ne]
96   exact not_congr convexHull_eq_empty
97 
98 protected alias ⟨_, Set.Nonempty.convexHull⟩ := convexHull_nonempty_iff
99 
100 theorem segment_subset_convexHull (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) : segment 𝕜 x y ⊆ convexHull 𝕜 s :=
101   (convex_convexHull _ _).segment_subset (subset_convexHull _ _ hx) (subset_convexHull _ _ hy)
102 
103 @[simp]
104 theorem convexHull_singleton (x : E) : convexHull 𝕜 ({x} : Set E) = {x} :=
105   (convex_singleton x).convexHull_eq
106 
107 @[simp] lemma convexHull_eq_singleton : convexHull 𝕜 s = {x} ↔ s = {x} where
108   mp hs := by
109     rw [← Set.Nonempty.subset_singleton_iff, ← hs]
110     · exact subset_convexHull ..
111     · by_contra! hs
112       simp_all [eq_comm (a := ∅)]
113   mpr hs := by simp [hs]
114 
115 @[simp]
116 theorem convexHull_zero : convexHull 𝕜 (0 : Set E) = 0 :=
117   convexHull_singleton 0
118 
119 @[simp] lemma convexHull_eq_zero : convexHull 𝕜 s = 0 ↔ s = 0 := convexHull_eq_singleton
120 
121 @[simp]
122 theorem convexHull_pair [IsOrderedRing 𝕜] (x y : E) : convexHull 𝕜 {x, y} = segment 𝕜 x y := by
123   refine (convexHull_min ?_ <| convex_segment _ _).antisymm
124     (segment_subset_convexHull (mem_insert _ _) <| subset_insert _ _ <| mem_singleton _)
125   rw [insert_subset_iff, singleton_subset_iff]
126   exact ⟨left_mem_segment _ _ _, right_mem_segment _ _ _⟩
127 
128 theorem convexHull_convexHull_union_left (s t : Set E) :
129     convexHull 𝕜 (convexHull 𝕜 s ∪ t) = convexHull 𝕜 (s ∪ t) :=
130   ClosureOperator.closure_sup_closure_left _ _ _
131 
132 theorem convexHull_convexHull_union_right (s t : Set E) :
133     convexHull 𝕜 (s ∪ convexHull 𝕜 t) = convexHull 𝕜 (s ∪ t) :=
134   ClosureOperator.closure_sup_closure_right _ _ _
135 
136 theorem Convex.convex_remove_iff_notMem_convexHull_remove {s : Set E} (hs : Convex 𝕜 s) (x : E) :
137     Convex 𝕜 (s \ {x}) ↔ x ∉ convexHull 𝕜 (s \ {x}) := by
138   constructor
139   · rintro hsx hx
140     rw [hsx.convexHull_eq] at hx
141     exact hx.2 (mem_singleton _)
142   rintro hx
143   suffices h : s \ {x} = convexHull 𝕜 (s \ {x}) by
144     rw [h]
145     exact convex_convexHull 𝕜 _
146   exact
147     Subset.antisymm (subset_convexHull 𝕜 _) fun y hy =>
148       ⟨convexHull_min diff_subset hs hy, by
149         rintro (rfl : y = x)
150         exact hx hy⟩
151 
152 theorem IsLinearMap.image_convexHull {f : E → F} (hf : IsLinearMap 𝕜 f) (s : Set E) :
153     f '' convexHull 𝕜 s = convexHull 𝕜 (f '' s) :=
154   Set.Subset.antisymm
155     (image_subset_iff.2 <|
156       convexHull_min (image_subset_iff.1 <| subset_convexHull 𝕜 _)
157         ((convex_convexHull 𝕜 _).is_linear_preimage hf))
158     (convexHull_min (image_mono (subset_convexHull 𝕜 s)) <|
159       (convex_convexHull 𝕜 s).is_linear_image hf)
160 
161 theorem LinearMap.image_convexHull (f : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) (s : Set E) :
162     f '' convexHull 𝕜 s = convexHull 𝕜 (f '' s) :=
163   f.isLinear.image_convexHull s
164 
165 theorem convexHull_add_subset {s t : Set E} :
166     convexHull 𝕜 (s + t) ⊆ convexHull 𝕜 s + convexHull 𝕜 t :=
167   convexHull_min (add_subset_add (subset_convexHull _ _) (subset_convexHull _ _))
168     (Convex.add (convex_convexHull 𝕜 s) (convex_convexHull 𝕜 t))
169 
170 end AddCommMonoid
171 
172 end OrderedSemiring

174 section CommSemiring
175 
176 variable [CommSemiring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜] [AddCommMonoid E] [Module 𝕜 E]
177 
178 theorem convexHull_smul (a : 𝕜) (s : Set E) : convexHull 𝕜 (a • s) = a • convexHull 𝕜 s :=
179   (LinearMap.lsmul _ _ a).image_convexHull _ |>.symm
180 
181 end CommSemiring
182 
183 section OrderedRing
184 
185 variable [Ring 𝕜] [PartialOrder 𝕜]
186 
187 section AddCommGroup
188 
189 variable [AddCommGroup E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module 𝕜 E] [Module 𝕜 F]
190 
191 theorem AffineMap.image_convexHull (f : E →ᵃ[𝕜] F) (s : Set E) :
192     f '' convexHull 𝕜 s = convexHull 𝕜 (f '' s) := by
193   apply Set.Subset.antisymm
194   · rw [Set.image_subset_iff]
195     refine convexHull_min ?_ ((convex_convexHull 𝕜 (f '' s)).affine_preimage f)
196     rw [← Set.image_subset_iff]
197     exact subset_convexHull 𝕜 (f '' s)
198   · exact convexHull_min (Set.image_mono (subset_convexHull 𝕜 s))
199       ((convex_convexHull 𝕜 s).affine_image f)
200 
201 theorem convexHull_subset_affineSpan (s : Set E) : convexHull 𝕜 s ⊆ (affineSpan 𝕜 s : Set E) :=
202   convexHull_min (subset_affineSpan 𝕜 s) (affineSpan 𝕜 s).convex
203 
204 @[simp]
205 theorem affineSpan_convexHull (s : Set E) : affineSpan 𝕜 (convexHull 𝕜 s) = affineSpan 𝕜 s := by
206   refine le_antisymm ?_ (affineSpan_mono 𝕜 (subset_convexHull 𝕜 s))
207   rw [affineSpan_le]
208   exact convexHull_subset_affineSpan s
209 
210 theorem convexHull_neg (s : Set E) : convexHull 𝕜 (-s) = -convexHull 𝕜 s := by
211   simp_rw [← image_neg_eq_neg]
212   exact AffineMap.image_convexHull (-1) _ |>.symm
213 
214 lemma convexHull_vadd (x : E) (s : Set E) : convexHull 𝕜 (x +ᵥ s) = x +ᵥ convexHull 𝕜 s :=
215   (AffineEquiv.constVAdd 𝕜 _ x).toAffineMap.image_convexHull s |>.symm
216 
217 end AddCommGroup

221 end convexHull
